title: Coded identity
summary: Development from the original commissioned SOS Morse-code mark into a wider SaveOurS coded identity.

lensAssignments.rationale: The responsibility centres on meaning, recognition, identity, visual language or the designed human experience.
The coded mark is defined as a repeatable visual system developing the original SOS Morse-code construction into SaveOurS.
lensAssignments.lensSummary: System and product-definition responsibility: development of a repeatable SaveOurS coded identity from the original SOS Morse-code construction.
